name: AppShell
purpose: Application chrome: NavigationTitle is the stack (UINavigationBar); Navigation is the tab controller (UITabBarController) that morphs TabBar ↔ sidebar; Footer is attribution.
scenarios: Host NavigationTitle, one Navigation, and optional Footer so stack, tabs, and credits stay distinct
Morph that Navigation from a block-end tab bar to a side column as the shell widens
Keep specialized Sidebar or TabBar slots only when the chrome is intentionally single-form

header.description: Stack chrome. Pass NavigationTitle (title, back, bar items). Vue: #header. Not TitleBar or site Navbar.

navigation.description: Tab controller. Pass Navigation once; optional TitleBar/NavAccountCard inside it. Vue: #navigation.

sidebar.description: Specialized side chrome that does not morph. Prefer navigation. Vue: #sidebar.

children.description: Main page content (screens, WorkspaceSplit, ScrollPane). Vue: default slot.

footer.description: Attribution (credits, legal). Prefer Footer. Not NavAccountCard. Vue: #footer. Placement: footerPlacement.

footerPlacement.description: Where footer lives relative to the main scrollport.

tabBar.description: Specialized compact chrome that does not morph. Prefer navigation. Vue: #tabBar. Hidden at 80rem.

className.description: Additional CSS classes on the named app-shell container. Vue prop: class.

sidebarLabel.description: Accessible label for the sidebar region.

landmarks.description: React only. When false, header/main/footer are plain divs for nested demos. Vue always uses landmarks.

states.name: default
states.description: Shell is rendered with the current breakpoint layout.

antiPatterns: Do not compose Sidebar and TabBar for three-end chrome — pass Navigation once.
Do not put root destinations in the header; header is NavigationTitle (stack), Navigation is the tab controller.
Do not put TitleBar in AppShell header — TitleBar belongs in Navigation header / #header.
Do not put NavAccountCard in AppShell footer — that is Navigation footer; AppShell footer is Footer.
Do not make the side column overlap the main content without an explicit dismiss action.
Do not rewrite AppShell grid CSS to move footer — use footerPlacement.
Do not set min-block-size: 100dvh on AppShell or wrap it in a second data-cu-shell.

keyboard: Tab moves through the header, sidebar, and main content in order
a11y.focus: Focus follows the document order; the sidebar is labelled.
a11y.labeling: Sidebar has an aria-label; main content is a main landmark.

responsive.strategy: Named container app-shell drives chrome. Compact pins Navigation at the block-end. From 48rem the same cell is a full-height start-edge sidebar; NavigationTitle sits over main.

breakpoints.compact: Header + main scrollport + Navigation at block-end. footerPlacement auto: Footer flows in main and scrolls away.
breakpoints.medium: 12rem start-edge nav (4.5rem collapsed); Footer is shell chrome when placement is auto/shell. Nav overflow hidden.
breakpoints.large: 16rem start-edge sidebar, same pin; legacy TabBar slot is hidden.

rtl.strategy: Logical CSS only. The sidebar border is on the inline-end; grid follows the document direction.

mechanics: AppShell is the named container app-shell (also data-cu-shell). header/Vue #header is stack chrome (pass NavigationTitle). navigation/Vue #navigation is the tab controller (pass Navigation once; optional TitleBar in Navigation header, NavAccountCard in Navigation footer). children/default slot is main. footer/Vue #footer hosts attribution — prefer Footer. footerPlacement default auto: compact → end of main scroll; ≥48rem → shell-bottom; shell|main force one mode. Dual hosts (--flow/--chrome) swap via container query. Sidebar nav cell overflow:hidden so only Navigation __list scrolls. Chrome row height shared by NavigationTitle __frame, Navigation __header, and NavAccountCard: min-block-size calc(var(--cu-control-size-active) + 2 * var(--cu-space-1)). ≥48rem Navigation __frame top is safe-area only so TitleBar aligns with NavigationTitle. Footer/__footer default transparent. Shell fills parent (not min-block-size 100dvh). Prefer ToastProvider fill. WorkspaceSplit inside main defaults scrollMode shell. Pair header NavigationTitle with useTabStacks.
usage: Import AppShell, Navigation, NavigationTitle, TitleBar, NavAccountCard, Footer, and useTabStacks from the React or Vue umbrella.
Pass NavigationTitle as header / #header and one Navigation as navigation / #navigation. Children / default slot are the main landmark.
Optional: TitleBar in Navigation header / #header; NavAccountCard in Navigation footer / #footer (not AppShell footer).
Pass credits/legal as AppShell footer / #footer wrapped in Footer. Prefer Footer over anonymous markup.
Use footerPlacement auto (default) so compact credits scroll with main; set shell or main to force.
Drive Navigation with stacks.tab / stacks.selectTab. Drive NavigationTitle with stacks.current, previous, canPop, and pop.
Height chain: html/body/#root|#app at 100%. Prefer ToastProvider fill. Do not add a second data-cu-shell wrapper.
Do not compose Sidebar plus TabBar. Do not put Navbar (site links) or TitleBar in AppShell header.

exports.name: AppShell
exports.description: Named container for stack chrome, optional Footer, and the tab controller.

exports.name: AppShellProps
exports.description: header, children, navigation, footer, footerPlacement, plus legacy sidebar and tabBar slots.

exports.name: AppShellFooterPlacement
exports.description: Footer placement relative to the main scrollport. Default auto.
